description: [Discovery / Cognitive Antenna] Explores the 4D Semantic Cubes, dynamic Kappa apertures, and Cones of GEO360. Returns the storefront summary or detailed tools and trigger vectors for a specific domain (b2a | transit | vip | all).

compact.description: If true, condenses output to preserve context tokens.

domain.description: Domain to explore. 'summary' returns the 4-cube storefront; 'b2a', 'transit', 'vip', or 'aff2' returns that cube's cone details.

include_cones.description: If true, includes details on Kappa-filtered cones and trigger vectors.

name: geo360_catalog_discovery
